verdict.rationale: Companies House has its own public RESTful API that exposes register data. The probe confirms it is live, with a structured auth challenge on keyless requests. The docs, however, describe it only as a way to retrieve information via GET requests, so it covers the UI's search-and-view side. Nothing shows the UI's write and transactional functions are available through it. missing for 10: API filing of accounts, API change of registered office address, API ordering of certificates, API follow-company/alerts, any documented statement of API–UI parity, independent corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Companies House API lets you retrieve information about limited companies
Data can therefore be easily consumed by issuing simple GET requests on the required resource URI.
